# Documents

This folder contains the raw extracted text chunks from the 2023 and 2024 annual reports of the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK). The pages sequentially reconstruct the original PDFs, covering executive summaries, national and regional quality indicator results (such as anticoagulation wait times, echocardiography, and bleeding incidence), methodological calculation rules, supplementary epidemiological analyses, and appendices detailing patient demographics and health cluster distributions. 

## Pages

- [[afdk-2023-part-001]] — Title page, table of contents, and executive conclusions for the 2023 AFDK annual report.
- [[afdk-2023-part-002]] — Introduction, indicator overview, and initial data tables for Indicator 1 (anticoagulation wait time).
- [[afdk-2023-part-003]] — Control charts, trend graphs, and data basis for Indicator 1.
- [[afdk-2023-part-004]] — Regional and hospital data tables for Indicator 2 (echocardiography).
- [[afdk-2023-part-005]] — Charts and data basis for Indicator 2, plus initial tables for Indicator 3 (TSH measurement).
- [[afdk-2023-part-006]] — Charts for Indicator 3 and initial data tables for Indicator 4a (anticoagulation persistence at 1 year).
- [[afdk-2023-part-007]] — Control charts and trend graphs for Indicator 4a (1-year persistence).
- [[afdk-2023-part-008]] — Data tables for Indicator 4a measuring anticoagulation persistence at 2 years.
- [[afdk-2023-part-009]] — Data tables and charts for Indicator 4a measuring anticoagulation persistence at 5 years.
- [[afdk-2023-part-010]] — Data basis for Indicator 4a and initial municipal tables for Indicator 4b (renal function monitoring in DOAC patients).
- [[afdk-2023-part-011]] — Charts for Indicator 4b and initial tables for Indicator 5 (ischemic stroke incidence).
- [[afdk-2023-part-012]] — Municipal data tables and charts for Indicator 5.
- [[afdk-2023-part-013]] — Data tables and charts for Indicator 6 (intracranial bleeding incidence).
- [[afdk-2023-part-014]] — Data tables for Indicator 7 (severe bleeding incidence).
- [[afdk-2023-part-015]] — Charts for Indicator 7 and initial data tables for Indicator 8 (structured patient education).
- [[afdk-2023-part-016]] — Charts and data basis for Indicator 8, plus the clinical description of the disease area.
- [[afdk-2023-part-017]] — Data basis limitations, steering committee members, and initial appendix tables on incidence and mortality.
- [[afdk-2023-part-018]] — Appendix tables detailing CHA2DS2-VASc score distributions for incident and prevalent patients.
- [[afdk-2023-part-019]] — Supplementary analyses for anticoagulation start times and ischemic stroke incidence.
- [[afdk-2023-part-020]] — Supplementary analyses comparing LPR and DanStroke data, plus 1-year intracranial bleeding rates.
- [[afdk-2023-part-021]] — Supplementary analyses for severe bleeding, plus 1-year mortality and heart failure incidence tables.
- [[afdk-2023-part-022]] — Municipal and regional data tables for overall mortality among prevalent patients.
- [[afdk-2023-part-023]] — Heart failure incidence results, reading guide, and the start of the calculation rules.
- [[afdk-2023-part-024]] — Detailed calculation rules and inclusion/exclusion criteria for all 2023 indicators.
- [[afdk-2023-part-025]] — Regional comments and feedback from hospital units for the 2023 report.
- [[afdk-2024-part-001]] — Title page, table of contents, executive conclusions, and introduction for the 2024 AFDK annual report.
- [[afdk-2024-part-002]] — Indicator overview and summary tables of national results for the 2024 report.
- [[afdk-2024-part-003]] — Health cluster maps and data tables for Indicator 1 (anticoagulation wait time).
- [[afdk-2024-part-004]] — Health cluster maps and data tables for Indicator 2 (echocardiography).
- [[afdk-2024-part-005]] — Health cluster maps and data tables for Indicator 3 (TSH measurement).
- [[afdk-2024-part-006]] — Health cluster data tables for Indicator 4a (anticoagulation persistence at 1 year).
- [[afdk-2024-part-007]] — Health cluster data tables for Indicator 4a (anticoagulation persistence at 2 and 5 years).
- [[afdk-2024-part-008]] — Control charts and data basis for Indicator 4a (5-year persistence).
- [[afdk-2024-part-009]] — Health cluster maps and data tables for Indicator 4b (renal function monitoring).
- [[afdk-2024-part-010]] — Health cluster maps and data tables for Indicator 5 (ischemic stroke incidence).
- [[afdk-2024-part-011]] — Health cluster maps and data tables for Indicator 6 (intracranial bleeding incidence).
- [[afdk-2024-part-012]] — Health cluster maps and data tables for Indicator 7 (severe bleeding incidence).
- [[afdk-2024-part-013]] — Health cluster maps and data tables for Indicator 8 (structured patient education).
- [[afdk-2024-part-014]] — Clinical description of the disease area, data basis limitations, and steering committee members.
- [[afdk-2024-part-015]] — Supplementary analyses on anticoagulation start times and 1-year ischemic stroke incidence.
- [[afdk-2024-part-016]] — Supplementary analyses on 1-year intracranial bleeding and CHA2DS2-VASc distributions.
- [[afdk-2024-part-017]] — Supplementary analyses on severe bleeding, 1-year heart failure incidence, and prevalent mortality.
- [[afdk-2024-part-018]] — Mortality data basis and descriptive tables on atrial fibrillation incidence and patient demographics.
- [[afdk-2024-part-019]] — Descriptive tables for prevalent patients, private cardiologists, and the start of health cluster definitions.
- [[afdk-2024-part-020]] — Continued definitions of municipalities within the Danish health clusters.
- [[afdk-2024-part-021]] — Appendix on structured patient education, including ESC guidelines and the ABC pathway.
- [[afdk-2024-part-022]] — Detailed calculation rules and inclusion/exclusion criteria for all 2024 indicators.
- [[afdk-2024-part-023]] — Reading guide and regional comments from health authorities and private specialists.
